CONFLICT 2030B triggers: the 2030B 8-K and indenture require the stock price to EXCEED 130% (strict). The 10-Q generic footnotes say 'greater than or equal to 130%' (conversion) and 'at least 130%' (call) for all notes. A 2030B call also requires the notes to be Freely Tradable, all special/additional interest paid, and the price test on the trading day before notice. The window ends on the 20th scheduled trading day before maturity. Its conversion-upon-redemption cut-off is the 2nd business day before the redemption date; the other notes use the 2nd scheduled trading day.

2030B: 8-K granted a $300M initial purchasers' option; $2.00B outstanding/at inception implies it was not exercised (inferred). 8-K net proceeds ~$1.99B vs 10-Q $1,984,852K / MD&A ~$1.98B. 2030B indenture Default Settlement Method is Physical Settlement (Company may change).

2029 repurchase: the 10-Q gives May 19, 2026 as the date. The Company repurchased $1.50B principal in privately negotiated transactions for $1.38B aggregate including third-party costs. The MD&A calls this ~8% discount to par, funded with cash reserves. The gain on extinguishment was ~$113.9M. The net carrying amount repurchased was ~$1.49B. The notes were canceled. 10-Q footnote (10) loosely calls it a 'redemption'. It was a negotiated repurchase, not an indenture call: the 2029 notes are not redeemable before 2026-12-04. No 8-K announcing the repurchase is among the converted files.

Fair value: Level 2 for all six notes at 2026-06-30 (last OTC trade price). Values are in $ thousands. Implied prices per 100 of par are mine, not from the filing: 2028 ~101.7, 2029 ~86.5, 2030A ~102.2, 2030B ~88.8, 2031 ~93.4, 2032 ~97.3.

Cash interest: the 10-Q gives only aggregate cash paid ($9.0M in Q2 2026, $17.3M in H1 2026) and '$17.3 million in aggregate coupon interest due each semi-annual period'. Per-note figures are contractual interest expense (10-Q table, $K/quarter): 2028 1,578; 2030A 1,250; 2031 1,320; 2032 4,500; 2029 and 2030B 0. These equal principal x coupon / 4. No additional or special interest has been paid to date.

Settlement for all six notes is cash, shares or a combination at the Company's election. Make-whole applies to all six on a make-whole fundamental change or notice of redemption. The 2030B make-whole on redemption applies only to called notes. The 5 older indentures (Section 14.03) and the 2030B indenture (Section 5.07) contain make-whole tables. Those tables were not extracted.
10-Q: none of the notes were convertible in H1 2026 and there were no conversion requests. 10-Q max-share counts use conversion rates then in effect; they exclude make-whole increases.

Ranking: 10-Q: all Outstanding Convertible Notes are senior unsecured. They are effectively junior to secured debt to the extent of collateral and structurally junior to subsidiaries' liabilities. The 2030B 8-K adds that they are senior to preferred equity (STRK).

Not found or not extracted: per-note cash interest actually paid; make-whole share tables; holder put notice mechanics; the 2027 notes, which were fully redeemed or converted in Q1 2025 and are out of scope. The 10-K FY2025 was ignored as instructed.
